sources.note: FWO's own programme page for the Junior postdoctoral fellowship (Research Foundation Flanders), read in full.

awarding_body.detail: The page is published by the Research Foundation Flanders (FWO) on its own domain; the footer states it is an official website of the Flemish government. It is the awarding body's own page, not an aggregator.
awarding_body.quote: fwo.be is an official website of the Flemish government published by FWO

deadline.detail: The call is currently open (call opened 17 September 2026) and the last application date is 16 November 2026 at 5pm, exactly as the record states. The record's deadline is for the currently-open cycle (today is 12 October 2026).
deadline.quote: 16 November 2026 at 5pm: call closes (last application date)

eligibility.detail: All record claims confirmed: PhD by thesis or an EU-recognised equivalent; PhD obtained no more than 3 years before 1 October of the fellowship start year (or to be defended by 15 September that year); a supervisor at a Flemish host institution; and the applicant must not have benefited from this fellowship before. The page additionally states an applicant may apply at most twice for the same fellowship.
eligibility.quote: You can apply for a junior postdoctoral fellowship if your PhD was obtained no longer than 3 years before October, 1 of the year in which the fellowship would start, or will be obtained at September 15 of that year at the latest

funding.detail: The fellowship is salaried and fully funded: a gross monthly salary of EUR 5,616.81 (at 4 years seniority) for three years, plus a bench fee of EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year. It is not a tuition-only award.
funding.quote: Gross monthly salary junior postdoctoral fellowship (4 years seniority): EUR 5,616.81 (index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026). Bench fee which can range from EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year

degree_levels.detail: The programme is a junior postdoctoral fellowship, i.e. postdoctoral level: it supports researchers who have recently obtained their doctorate. The page also notes that holders may apply for a senior postdoctoral fellowship immediately afterwards.
degree_levels.quote: This fellowship supports researchers who have recently obtained their doctorate and aim to pursue an independent research career.

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Verified live on fwo.be: Status Open; call opened 17 September 2026, closes 16 November 2026 at 5pm; preselection 18-25 March 2027; interviews 14 April - 5 May 2027; results announced 13 May 2027; fellowship starts 1 October or 1 November 2027. New for the 2027 call: a second application for the same fellowship type is only possible if the first was among the top 50% in preselection; supervisors may support at most five applications per call; the supervisor's letter of recommendation is a mandatory evaluation criterion. Maximum two applications for the same fellowship.
